thread:
anne-docs: Heads-up — PR with guidance on audit-log sampling + retention edge cases is ready. Need security + legal review and short SDK snippets (py/ts/curl). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5823

mike-security: Thanks — will review. Two asks up front: (1) avoid words like 'indefinitely' or 'may keep' in SOC2-facing copy, (2) clarify sampling vs full-export when there's a legal hold.

anne-docs: Noted. Draft line is: 'Retained audit logs are stored for 90 days by default; exports for compliance may be kept longer under legal hold.' Is that SOC2-safe? Open to wording.

mike-security: Prefer: 'Customer audit logs are retained for 90 days by default. Legal holds or regulatory obligations may extend retention; access and export controls are applied.' Avoid 'we may keep' phrasing. :+1:

pratyusha-eng: For the SDK snippets — here's a minimal python sampling example to surface into the doc: ```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient()
# sample ~1% of events over the last 30 days
resp = client.query_events(sample=0.01, start='2025-02-01', end='2025-03-03')
print(resp.get('count'))
```

anne-docs: Nice. Can you also add a TypeScript example and a simple curl example for ops?

pratyusha-eng: Sure — TS example: ```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood.AuditClient()
const resp = await client.queryEvents({ sample: 0.01, start: '2025-02-01', end: '2025-03-03' })
console.log(resp.count)
```

pratyusha-eng: And quick curl for sampled query: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/query \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"sample":0.01, "start":"2025-02-01", "end":"2025-03-03"}'
```

jordan-legal: Quick legal note: please phrase retention as 'as required by law or contractual obligations' and include a contact for legal holds. Also stipulate that example IDs are pseudonymized.

anne-docs: Added legal@redwood.com for legal-hold contact and a line about pseudonymized IDs. Do we want a tiny pseudonymization example?

mike-security: Yes — show a tiny transform example that replaces user_id with a hash. Keep it short and illustrative.

pratyusha-eng: Added example JSON (pseudonymized): ```json
{
  "user_id": "sha256:3f2a...",
  "action": "model.query",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```

doc-bot: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5823/files — requested reviewers: @mike-security @jordan-legal @pratyusha-eng

lina-ml: FYI — added a short callout about sampling bias: sampled audit sets can under-represent rare anomalies, so we recommend full exports before major compliance investigations. Linked to monitoring playbook.

anne-docs: Good catch — added that note and a link to the monitoring playbook.

mike-security: LGTM with one tiny wording tweak in the first paragraph (I'll push an inline suggestion in the PR).

anne-docs: Awesome, thanks everyone. Plan to merge Wed after security sign-off. @doc-bot please add the 'security-reviewed' label when merged.
